title: Grateful Dead Live at Shrine Exposition Hall on 1967-11-10
source: Source: 8 Track Master Reel > 1st Gen Reel (7.5ips) > PCM (Sony Beta ESXHiFi/L-750) - Given to Tim Dalton by Bob Menke; Transfer: PCM > Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch Pro > Tascam DA-3000 > WAV 16/44.1 - Transferred By Charlie Miller; Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 1.5 > iZotope RX6 Advanced > iZotope 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16; edited and mastered SIRMick February 2018

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a legendary 1967 show – the 15‑minute Viola Lee Blues, soaring Morning Dew and volcanic Caution shine on crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The recording is an outstanding SBD (sound‑board) source with pristine clarity that lets every instrument sparkle. The performance itself is a tour‑de‑force of early Dead brilliance – a monumental Viola Lee Blues, a baroque‑fast Morning Dew, killer Alligator and a searing Caution are repeatedly highlighted as peak ’67 moments.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity; most give 5‑star ratings, with only a few 4‑star notes about minor source quirks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the SBD as crystal‑clear, pristine and “amazing sounding”; one note mentions a slight repitch/wider image but no significant flaws.

standout_songs: Caution (Do Not Step on the Tracks)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its epic opening, seamless segues (e.g., Cryptical into TOO and then Alligator), and a strong, energetic pacing that keeps the early‑'67 vibe alive throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for rapid‑fire solos, inventive licks during Viola Lee Blues and fiery riffs in Schoolgirl and Alligator.
band_member_comments.Phil: Noted as more aggressive than earlier in the year, with clear bass presence on many tracks.
band_member_comments.Bob: Pigpen’s organ work is described as “holds his own” and his vocals on Schoolgirl and Caution are highlighted as magical.
band_member_comments.Keys: Organ/keyboard playing (Pigpen) praised for strength; a reviewer muses about possible synth‑like tones in New Potato Caboose.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey’s congas add texture to Alligator; overall drum foundation described as solid.
